acceptance_criteria.criterion: Freeform search input filters the project list in real-time by matching against project name, ID, and description (case-insensitive substring match).
Repository filter dropdown filters the project list to only projects containing the selected repository.

Sort selector toggles between alphabetical (name ascending, case-insensitive; tiebreaker: project ID ascending) and last-activity (descending; null/undefined LastActivity sorts last; tiebreaker: name ascending).
Clearing all filters (empty search, "All repositories", any sort order) restores the full project list.
An empty-state message "No projects match the current filters." is displayed when filter criteria yield zero results.
After creating a new project, all project data is re-fetched from the API and the current filter/sort state is re-applied.
DOM clearing uses clearElement() from utils/dom.js — no innerHTML = '' for container clearing.

summary: Added module-level `_allProjects` cache array to dashboard.js — stores enriched project data (fullProject + wsCount) after each API fetch.

Implemented `applyFiltersAndSort(filterState)` — applies search (case-insensitive substring on name/ID/description), repo filter (project must contain the selected repo ID), and sort (alpha: name asc + ID tiebreaker; activity: desc timestamp, null last, name tiebreaker).

Implemented `renderProjectGrid(listContainer, filtered)` — renders cards or the appropriate empty-state message using clearElement(); distinguishes 'no projects at all' from 'filters excluded everything'.
Refactored `renderProjectList(listContainer, filterState)` — now accepts filterState, populates `_allProjects`, then calls applyFiltersAndSort + renderProjectGrid.
Wired `onFilterChange` in renderDashboard to call applyFiltersAndSort + renderProjectGrid (no re-fetch on filter change).
Updated create-project `onSuccess` handler to call `renderProjectList(listContainer, filterState)` so data is re-fetched from the API and the current filter/sort state is re-applied.
All AC7 container-clearing uses clearElement() — no innerHTML = '' introduced.
Added gui/public/js/views/dashboard.test.mjs with 14 tests covering all 7 acceptance criteria. All 14 new tests + 100 pre-existing GUI tests pass (114 total).

comments.note: dashboard.js uses `innerHTML` in the `showLoading()` helper (line ~141) to inject the loading skeleton. This is a pre-existing pattern predating WP-001. Consider refactoring showLoading() to build the DOM imperatively using createElement + clearElement() for consistency with the rest of the module.

`applyFiltersAndSort()` reads the `_allProjects` module-level variable implicitly. Making it a pure function (accepting `allProjects` as a parameter) would improve testability and make the data flow explicit. Currently testable only through the rendered DOM.

The `alpha` sort comparator in `applyFiltersAndSort()` uses explicit `<`/`>` string comparisons rather than `String.prototype.localeCompare()`, which is inconsistent with the activity sort's tiebreaker that uses `localeCompare`. Unifying to `localeCompare` throughout would improve locale-correctness consistency.

Alpha sort uses explicit `<`/`>` comparisons while activity sort tiebreaker uses localeCompare(). Inconsistency pre-flagged by Developer. No AC violation, but a locale-correctness improvement opportunity.
Edge-case verified: projects with empty Repositories array correctly trigger the empty-state when a repo filter is applied — no runtime crash.
Debounce timing verified: 5 rapid keystrokes at 20ms intervals (well within the 250ms window) fire only one filter evaluation reflecting the final input value.

comments.note: Alpha sort comparator in applyFiltersAndSort() (lines ~484-494) replaced explicit `<`/`>` string comparisons with localeCompare(). applyFiltersAndSort() closes over the module-level _allProjects array. This is an acceptable tradeoff for the current single-instance dashboard model. If dashboard.js is ever instantiated multiple times (e.g. tabs, multi-route caching), the shared cache would need to become instance-local or accept allProjects as a parameter. Flagged as future-context debt, not a blocker.
